scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n business,client "npm run dev -w @barber/business" "npm run dev -w @barber/client"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:database: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx --test tests/database.integration.ts tests/appointments.integration.ts tests/catalog.integration.ts tests/staff-accounts.integration.ts tests/schedules.integration.ts tests/availability.integration.ts tests/guest-bookings.integration.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
